battle.dash.hint: Dash in your last movement direction. Escape a warning just before impact for a perfect dodge.
battle.excitement.note: Drag to steer; Dash follows your last direction (up before your first move). Combine two modules to evolve your weapon. Watch for bonus wave events.
evolution.fireVortex.detail: Fire Core + Overclock Module: three orbiting fireballs burn nearby enemies.
evolution.stormCage.detail: Tesla Coil + a splitting module: an electric ring damages and slows enemies.
evolution.siegeBarrage.detail: Explosive Payload + Critical Processor: marked artillery strikes land after a short delay.
event.eliteAmbush.detail: Defeat the marked elite squad before time runs out: +60 scrap.
event.scrapStorm.detail: Dodge the falling scrap and survive the countdown: +40 scrap.
event.treasureCarrier.detail: Destroy the fleeing gold carrier before it escapes: +40 scrap.
